Players Committee card image of [[Blizzard Scout 1 (V)]] (original printing), game text: “May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May move as a 'react.' During battle, if with your piloted AT-AT, may cancel game text of an opponent's character present.”
